# Security Policy

This repository is Ably's fork of Laravel Echo: `@ably/laravel-echo` and its React, Vue and Svelte packages. Please don't report a security vulnerability in a public GitHub issue, discussion or pull request.

## Reporting a vulnerability

[provisional: user to confirm the security contact]

Email [disclosure@ably.com](mailto:disclosure@ably.com), as described in Ably's [vulnerability disclosure policy](https://ably.com/disclosure). Please include:

- the affected package and version;
- a description of the vulnerability and its impact;
- the steps to reproduce it, or a proof of concept.

<!-- Once a repository admin enables GitHub private vulnerability reporting for ably-forks/laravel-echo, add it here as a second route: "Or use 'Report a vulnerability' on the repository's Security tab." It is disabled today. -->

For questions that are not about a vulnerability, contact [Ably support](https://ably.com/support).
